rendered.overview: [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] leads a Lesson and Ally deck in the Non-black lands' colors. Ramp and bending effects fuel card draw, then the commander transforms to drain four life from each opponent. [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] plus an Aang creature is a backup infinite-loop line.

strategy: Ramp with [[Bender's Waterskin]] and [[Hermitic Herbalist]] so the commander arrives around turn 3.
Use [[Toph, Hardheaded Teacher]] and [[Rumble Arena]]-style lands to earthbend, with airbend effects for more triggers.
Bend all four elements in one turn to draw cards and transform [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]].
Transform at upkeep to draw four cards and deal 4 damage to each opponent.
Backup: [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] with an Aang creature and the commander makes infinite enters and leaves.

keep: [[Hermitic Herbalist]] with a cheap Lesson gets the engine moving.
[[Toph, Hardheaded Teacher]] plus cheap spells starts earthbending early.
sendBack: Hands missing a way to bend or fix all five colors.
Expensive [[Water Whip]] with no ramp or creatures.

tips.text: [[Uncle Iroh]] makes Lessons cheaper, and each Lesson cast adds extra earthbending counters with [[Toph, Hardheaded Teacher]].
[[Katara, the Fearless]] doubles Ally triggers like [[Haru, Hidden Talent]] earthbending whenever another Ally enters.

keyCards.job: Draws on every bend, then transforms to drain.

Airbends on entering; part of the loop.

weaknesses: Moderate: Only 2 interaction pieces, 1 at instant speed, so a fast combo from [[Thassa's Oracle]] gets through.
Moderate: Removal like [[Swords to Plowshares]] on [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] stops the draw engine and the transform drain.
Moderate: Wins rely on combat and one transform drain, so [[Propaganda]] or fog effects slow it down.

plans.primary: Cast [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] and trigger it by waterbending, earthbending, firebending and airbending in one turn to draw cards and transform it.
backups: Assemble [[Aang, the Last Airbender]] or [[Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury]] with [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]] and [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] for infinite creature enters, leaves and tokens.
Build a wide board of Ally tokens and earthbent lands, then grow it with counters and attack.

assessment.line: [[Rest in Peace]] weakens Lesson-count payoffs like [[Gran-Gran]] and [[Bumi, King of Three Trials]].
Only 2 interaction pieces, 1 at instant speed, so a fast combo from [[Thassa's Oracle]] gets through.
Removal like [[Swords to Plowshares]] on [[Avatar Aang // Aang, Master of Elements]] stops the draw engine and the transform drain.
Wins rely on combat and one transform drain, so [[Propaganda]] or fog effects slow it down.
The backup loop needs [[Appa, Steadfast Guardian]], so a counterspell like [[Counterspell]] or exile breaks it.
Black is not produced by the lands, and the many basics risk clunky draws without [[Chromatic Lantern]].
